title: OAuth custom identity claims for service principal tokens will soon be available
body:
Applications will be able to attach a custom identity claim to the OAuth tokens they request for a service principal, by adding the `custom_claim` parameter to a token request that uses the `client_credentials` or `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange` grant type. You can then read the value in SQL with the `current_oauth_custom_identity_claim()` function.

Use custom identity claims to serve many end users through one service principal while each user sees only their own data. A dynamic view filters rows by comparing a column to the claim. The Genie Conversation API, the SQL Statement Execution API, and the Databricks JDBC Driver honor the claim.

If a token has no custom identity claim, the function returns `NULL`. Write filters that match no rows when the claim is `NULL`.

See [Authorize service principal access to Databricks with OAuth](/aws/en/dev-tools/auth/oauth-m2m) and [Use the Genie Agents API](/aws/en/genie-agents/conversation-api).
